# Triage completion

Retain a decision with bounded reasons and observed evidence.

- Project: assess fit against Project goals and any selected rules, and identify duplicate candidates.
- Systems analyst: classify eligible tasks by priority, kind, size, severity, component, risk, dependencies, reproducibility and recommended route.
- Review or needs-input: record missing facts and unresolved evidence.

Distinguish verified facts from assessments. Keep unverified reproduction unresolved. Report configured provider delivery separately.

These criteria complete triage; they are not ticket-authored implementation acceptance or proof of a delivered fix.
